claims.claim_text: A child fell in love with the santur (summary compression).
claims.evidence_quote: شروع کردم به زدن روی سیمها ... آخر شب به زور من رو از پای ساز بلند کردن
claims.reasoning: Source narrates the age-seven night of first playing and being pulled away, then months of nagging for a santur; summary rephrase keeps identical meaning.

claims.claim_text: For years the narrator coped with the diatonic tuning limitation.
claims.evidence_quote: سنتور یه ساز دیاتونیک هست ... باید کوک عوض بشه که خب زمانبره
claims.reasoning: Source spans childhood learning to a recent keyed instrument; years of living with the retuning limit is directly implied by the narrative arc.

claims.claim_text: The keyed santur brought modulation freedom.
claims.evidence_quote: این یعنی میشد سریع از هر دستگاهی به هر دستگاه دیگه برم، فقط با چند کلیک، فقط در چند ثانیه
claims.reasoning: Source states fast movement between any dastgah in seconds with the keyed instrument; summary compression preserves meaning.

claims.claim_text: Theme 1 header: on a night at age seven, with the aunt's santur and Zard-e Malijeh, fell in love with the instrument (stated as fact).
claims.evidence_quote: یه آهنگ هم برامون زد، زرد ملیجه بود فکر کنم
claims.reasoning: Source hedges the song identification with فکر کنم (I think); the header drops the hedge and states it absolutely, so at most Partially supported. Impact is minor because sub-point 1.1 retains the hedge.

claims.claim_text: The narrator was seven years old.
claims.evidence_quote: ۷ سالم که بود یه شب شام خونه خاله‌م بودیم
claims.reasoning: Exact number match with the source opening.

claims.claim_text: The aunt's santur was in the corner of the room.
claims.evidence_quote: تو کنج اتاق بود
claims.reasoning: Direct restatement of the source location detail.

claims.claim_text: She played Zard-e Malijeh, I think (hedged).
claims.evidence_quote: زرد ملیجه بود فکر کنم
claims.reasoning: Preserves both the song name and the source hedge فکر کنم; identical meaning.

claims.claim_text: It was one of the first pieces taught in santur training.
claims.evidence_quote: از اولین آهنگهاییه که تو آموزش سنتور یاد میدن
claims.reasoning: Direct rephrase of the source statement about early santur lessons.

claims.claim_text: The narrator learned mezrab holding from the aunt.
claims.evidence_quote: مضراب دست گرفتن رو بهم نشون داد
claims.reasoning: Source states the aunt showed how to hold the mezrab; same meaning.

claims.claim_text: At night's end they forcibly lifted the narrator from the instrument to go home.
claims.evidence_quote: آخر شب به زور من رو از پای ساز بلند کردن که بریم خونه
claims.reasoning: Exact match to the source memory of that night.

claims.claim_text: Probably the narrator was away from the instrument only at dinner time.
claims.evidence_quote: احتمالا فقط موقع شام پای ساز نبودم
claims.reasoning: Preserves the احتمالا (probably) hedge and the dinner-only detail.

claims.claim_text: The narrator nagged all the way home wanting a santur.
claims.evidence_quote: تمام طول راه رو زر زدم که سنتور میخوام
claims.reasoning: Direct rephrase of the source nagging episode.

claims.claim_text: The nagging and insistence continued for six months.
claims.evidence_quote: شیش ماه که این زر زدن‌ها و لج‌کردن‌ها ادامه داشت
claims.reasoning: Duration matches source exactly.

claims.claim_text: A santur was bought for the narrator at a discount (Theme 2 header).
claims.evidence_quote: بالاخره برام یه سنتور خریدن. ۲۰هزار تومن، با تخفیف شد ۱۸هزار تومن
claims.reasoning: Header compression of the purchase episode; meaning preserved.

claims.claim_text: The narrator went to class with an instrument bigger than herself/himself.
claims.evidence_quote: سازم از خودم گنده‌تر بود و به زور میکشیدمش که ببرمش سر کلاس
claims.reasoning: Header compression; same meaning as the source sentence.

claims.claim_text: Price was 20 thousand toman, discounted to 18 thousand.
claims.evidence_quote: ۲۰هزار تومن، با تخفیف شد ۱۸هزار تومن
claims.reasoning: Both numbers match source exactly, discount relation intact.

claims.claim_text: Six months later the narrator started classes.
claims.evidence_quote: شیش ماه بعدتر هم رفتم کلاس و شروع کردم به یاد گرفتن
claims.reasoning: Duration and event match source exactly.

claims.claim_text: At first the teacher came to the house.
claims.evidence_quote: اوایل استادم میومد خونه، چون تو شهرمون آموزشگاهی نبود
claims.reasoning: Direct restatement; the reason (no school in town) is omitted but the claim itself is fully stated in source.

claims.claim_text: The living room was colder than the other rooms, at least as remembered.
claims.evidence_quote: سردتر از بقیه اتاقها. حداقل اینطور تو ذهن من مونده
claims.reasoning: Preserves both the cold-room detail and the memory hedge.

claims.claim_text: Later the Ershad office set up a class where the teacher taught.
claims.evidence_quote: بعدترها اداره ارشاد کلاس دایر کرد و استادم همونجا تدریس میکرد
claims.reasoning: Direct restatement of the source event.

claims.claim_text: The sofas were only used when there were guests.
claims.evidence_quote: مبل‌ها هم تو اون اتاق بودن و فقط وقتی مهمون داشتیم استفاده میشدن
claims.reasoning: Exact detail match including the فقط (only) qualifier.

claims.claim_text: The instrument was bigger than the narrator.
claims.evidence_quote: سازم از خودم گنده‌تر بود
claims.reasoning: Repeats the source sentence; supported (duplicate of C15 for concision).

claims.claim_text: The santur has 72 strings and tuning it is not just anyone's job.
claims.evidence_quote: لاکردار ۷۲ تا سیم داره و کار هرکسی نیست کوک کردنش
claims.reasoning: Count and difficulty claim match source exactly.

claims.claim_text: Time-consuming tuning confined the diatonic santur to one game at the party (Theme 3 header).
claims.evidence_quote: حس بچه‌ای رو داشته باشم که تو مهمونی بهش فقط اجازه یه بازی رو داده باشن
claims.reasoning: Header fuses the tuning mechanism with the source analogy; meaning preserved.

claims.claim_text: With the tuner, no need to carry the instrument to class for tuning.
claims.evidence_quote: بعدترها که تیونر اومد بازار دیگه نیاز نبود ساز رو ببرم سر کلاس چون دیگه خودم میتونستم کوکش کنم
claims.reasoning: Direct rephrase of the tuner episode.

claims.claim_text: The santur is a diatonic instrument.
claims.evidence_quote: سنتور یه ساز دیاتونیک هست
claims.reasoning: Definition quoted near-verbatim.

claims.claim_text: Only one dastgah/scale at a time; modulation needs a time-consuming retune.
claims.evidence_quote: در آن واحد فقط میشه یک دستگاه/گام رو روش نواخت و اگه بخوای مدلاسیون انجام بدی باید کوک عوض بشه که خب زمانبره
claims.reasoning: Preserves the فقط (only) scope qualifier and the time cost.

claims.claim_text: Like a child allowed only one game; if tired of it, switching did not pay off.
claims.evidence_quote: اگه از اون بازی خسته میشدم ... باید اول همه اسباب‌بازی‌هام رو جمع میکردم ... نمیصرفید، تا اون موقع حس بازی میرفت
claims.reasoning: Faithful compression of the toy analogy including the نمیصرفید payoff point.

claims.claim_text: When other kids switched games, the narrator had to sit silently in a corner watching, even if she/he loved that game.
claims.evidence_quote: من مجبور بودم ساکت بشینم یه گوشه‌ای و نگاهشون کنم. حتی اگه اون بازی رو خیلی دوست داشتم
claims.reasoning: Preserves the حتی اگه (even if) qualifier and the enforced silence.

claims.claim_text: A keyed santur inspired by the harp brought quarter-tone change down to seconds (Theme 4 header).
claims.evidence_quote: یه سنتوری درست کردن که از چنگ ایده گرفتن و یه سری کلید تعبیه کردن
claims.reasoning: Header compression of the harp-inspired key mechanism; meaning preserved.

claims.claim_text: The keys lower any note by a quarter or half tone in a fraction of a second.
claims.evidence_quote: ربع یا نیم پرده زیرتر کردن هر نتی رو در کسری از ثانیه میشه انجام داد
claims.reasoning: Amounts and time unit match source exactly.

claims.claim_text: Modulation between dastgahs became a matter of seconds.
claims.evidence_quote: فقط در چند ثانیه
claims.reasoning: Matches the source چند ثانیه claim.

claims.claim_text: The narrator had been thinking about it for about two years.
claims.evidence_quote: دو سالی بود که بهش فکر میکردم
claims.reasoning: Duration matches source including the approximative سالی form.

claims.claim_text: She/he did not know how to bring it safely from Langroud to Langford.
claims.evidence_quote: نمی‌دونستم چطور میتونم سالم از لنگرود بیارمش لنگفورد
claims.reasoning: Place names and the سالم (safely) qualifier preserved.

claims.claim_text: With help of family, friends, officials and imams it arrived today.
claims.evidence_quote: با کمکهای بی دریغ خانواده و دوستان و مسئولین و ائمه امروز رسید به دستم
claims.reasoning: Helper list and امروز (today) match source.

claims.claim_text: Played from Isfahan to Homayun without pause (Theme 5 header).
claims.evidence_quote: از اصفهان به سه‌گاه، از سه‌گاه به نوا، از نوا به شور، از شور به همایون
claims.reasoning: Header names the endpoints; the full chain is detailed in 5.1.

claims.claim_text: Now facing a week-long trip, awaiting the return.
claims.evidence_quote: از فردا یک هفته‌ای مسافرتم ... نرفته منتظرم برگردم
claims.reasoning: Header compression of the closing trip/return lines.

claims.claim_text: Moved Isfahan to Segah to Nava to Shur to Homayun, as if dreaming.
claims.evidence_quote: انگار داشتم خواب میدیدم
claims.reasoning: Chain of dastgahs and the dream simile both match source.

claims.claim_text: Like a fattened sheep running, skipped lunch, back hurt from playing.
claims.evidence_quote: حکم گوسفند پرواری‌ای رو داشتم ... نهار نخوردم ... اینقدر که پشتم درد گرفت
claims.reasoning: All three details (sheep simile, skipped lunch, back pain) are stated in source.

claims.claim_text: Felt like the first night the aunt handed over the mezrabs.
claims.evidence_quote: حس شب اولی رو داشتم که خاله‌م مضراب‌های سنتور رو داد دستم
claims.reasoning: Direct restatement of the source feeling.

claims.claim_text: Like a child who could play any game, like one who could say anything.
claims.evidence_quote: حس بچه‌ای رو داشتم که هر بازی‌ای که دوست داشت میتونست بکنه، حس کسی رو داشتم که هر حرفی رو میخواست میتونست بزنه
claims.reasoning: Both similes preserved with original scope.

claims.claim_text: From tomorrow, traveling for about a week.
claims.evidence_quote: از فردا یک هفته‌ای مسافرتم
claims.reasoning: Matches source timing exactly (duplicate of C37 for concision).

claims.claim_text: Not yet gone, already waiting to return and sit at the instrument.
claims.evidence_quote: نرفته منتظرم برگردم و بشینم پای ساز
claims.reasoning: Closing line restated with identical meaning.

fail_list: C04: Theme 1 header states the Zard-e Malijeh identification as fact while the source hedges with فکر کنم; minor because sub-point 1.1 (C07) retains the hedge.
